title: PUCN Order — Docket 25-12018 (2026-07-09)
text:

Application of Flying Bull Internet, LLC d/b/a )

telecommunication service conducted under ) Docket No. 25-12018
Certificate of Public Convenience and Necessity )
(“CPC”) 3110. )
)

At a general session of the Public Utilities
Commission of Nevada, held at its offices
on June 30, 2026.

PRESENT: — Chair Hayley Williamson
Commissioner Tammy Cordova
Commissioner Randy J. Brown
Assistant Commission Secretary Trisha Osborne
ORDER
The Public Utilities Commission of Nevada (“Commission”) makes the following
findings of fact and conclusions of law:
1. INTRODUCTION
Flying Bull Internet, LLC d/b/a NOVOS FIBER (“NOVOS FIBER”) filed with the
Commission an application, designated as Docket No. 25-12018, to voluntarily discontinue
telecommunication service conducted under CPC 3110.
I. SUMMARY
The Commission grants the application and cancels CPC 3110.
Il. PROCEDURAL HISTORY
* On December 31, 2025, NOVOS FIBER filed the application pursuant to Nevada Revised
Statutes (“NRS”) and the Nevada Administrative Code Chapters 703 and 704, including, but not
limited to, NRS 704.390.

* The Regulatory Operations Staff of the Commission (“Staff”) participates as a matter of right
pursuant to NRS 703.301.

* On January 5, 2026, the Commission issued a Notice of Application to Discontinue
Telecommunication Service.

Docket No. 25-12018 Page 2

* On June 25, 2026, Staff filed a briefing memorandum (“Staffs Briefing Memorandum”).

* On June 30, 2026, the Commission voted to adopt the recommendations contained within
Staffs Briefing Memorandum.

IV. APPLICATION
NOVOS FIBER’s Request

1. NOVOS FIBER seeks to voluntarily discontinue telecommunications service
conducted under CPC 3110. (Application at 1.) NOVOS FIBER states that it has never operated
in Nevada and that it has no customers; therefore, there are no customers whose service would be
impacted by this cancellation. (/d.)
Staff's Position

2. Staff states that NOVOS FIBER is current on regulatory obligations and that no
customers in Nevada will be impacted by this cancellation. (Staff's Briefing Memorandum at 1.)
Staff recommends that the Commission issue an order granting NOVOS FIBER’s application
and cancelling CPC 3110. (/d.)
Commission Discussion and Findings

3. The Commission adopts the analysis and recommendations contained in Staffs
Briefing Memorandum. The Commission finds that no customers in Nevada will be harmed by
the discontinuance of telecommunication services. Accordingly, consistent with Staffs
recommendations, and pursuant to NRS 704.390, the Commission grants the application and
cancels CPC 3110.

Therefore, it is ordered:

1. The application of Flying Bull Internet, LLC d/b/a NOVOS FIBER, designated as

Docket No. 25-12018, is granted.
